definition: The light kasina as a meditative totality theme.
notes: Citation removed in the 2026-11-09 Wave 12 audit: the record cited MN 77, whose ten kasiṇa bases end with the space and consciousness kasiṇas and contain no light kasiṇa. AN 10.25 gives the same ten. The light kasiṇa belongs to later lists, so the record is uncited.
